data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact 084384ac0b1e inherits the case-level falsification-capacity criterion from SRC_001 (the record must contain an operation whose result could have contradicted the claim) and sharpens it into a single-run diagnostic compatible with the population-level skepticism of SRC_003. The inheritance is mediated by SCR_002's perturbation test: the ablation substitutes a contradicting execution result and measures verdict sensitivity, operationalizing 'could have contradicted' at the run level without requiring population statistics. The inheritance preserves the case-level anchor (each run record is individually auditable) while integrating SRC_003's demand for discriminating evidence. It is refuted if the single-run perturbation test is shown to be gameable — a restater could pass the ablation by mechanically flipping its verdict on any perturbed input regardless of whether the perturbation is truth-relevant — or if SRC_001's falsification-capacity criterion is demonstrably insufficient for the cases SRC_003's negative controls were designed to catch.
